texts.zh:
不幸的是，我们已经引起了这只生物的注意。它的头向一侧倾斜，一排鳞状的刺从颈部向外伸出。这只闪闪发光的动物，向我们这边发出急促而有节奏的声音。

我们没办法再继续研究它了。

我们预测它面对在强烈的火焰是，应该也会如同这里大多数的生物一样脆弱。不过，现在最好还是逃走，减少损失。
texts.en:
Unfortunately, we have drawn the attention of the creature. Head tilted to the side, an arrangement of scaled spines lifted outward from its neck. With quick, rhythmic pulses, the shimmering beast sent audible sounds in our direction.

We'll be unable to study it any further.

We predict it would be quite vulnerable if exposed to intense flame, as most of the other life around here tends to be. However, it may be best to escape now and cut our losses.

texts.zh:
这个地方固有的危险不值得去冒险。

我们已拉回锚链，让我们的[explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural]回到了安全的地方。

我们找到的样本有一些独特有趣的特性。
texts.en:
The inherent danger of this place was not worth the risk.

We have pulled the retrievable anchor and returned our [explorer.GetTeamMemberPlural] to safety.

The samples we have recovered have some uniquely interesting properties.

texts.zh:
这家伙对火并不陌生。

我们一点燃第一缕火苗，它就惊慌地跑开了——动作之快，一定是出于某种本能。

也许它早就意识到了这个环境的易燃特性。不管是什么原因，它已经逃到了不知道哪个犄角旮旯里以至于我们在任何传感器范围内都找不到它的任何迹象。

它离开以后，我们找到了它撤退时掉下的一件东西。应该是因为太重了带不动所以被丢了下来。

我们简单的实验表明，无论把这个物体放在哪里，它都会立即长出微小的卷须，寻找新的地方定居和繁衍。只要有水分，这些卷须就会聚集起来茁壮成长。

令人震惊的是，由此产生的植物显示出独特的智慧迹象，即使是在嫩芽时期。

我们觉得它甚至可以成为我们帝国的宝贵资产。
texts.en:
The creature was no stranger to fire.

As soon as we sparked the first flame, it skittered away in alarm - a behavior so quick it must be some sort of instinct.

Perhaps it was aware of the flammable properties of this environment. Whatever the reason, it has retreated so far into the cracks and crevices of this place that we no longer detect any sign of it within any range of sensors.

After it departed, we recovered an object it dropped during its retreat. It must have been too much of a burden to carry along.

Our brief experiments have shown that wherever this object is placed, it immediately begins sending out microscopic tendrils to scout out new areas to settle and flourish. At the merest detection of moisture, those tendrils congregate and thrive.

Shockingly, the resulting plant exhibits unique signs of intelligence, even as a young sprout.

We suspect it could even be raised as a valuable asset to our empire.

label.zh: 完美。无论怎么取样它都会再生。
label.en: Perfect. No matter how much we sample, it regenerates.
